research_notes: Blocked: substantial nonparliamentary roles recovered from primary testimony and candidate coverage, but nonpolitical employment dates/FTE are missing. Political, union and advocacy work is separately excluded.
Public LinkedIn profile search showed United Voice and qualifications, but opening the profile failed. No access restriction was bypassed and no unviewed profile dates were used.
Need dated QUT/IHBI appointments and Logan placement/pay status. Election candidacies are not treated as elected service or employment. Approximate five-year Parenthood claim retained in prose only.

2026-10-01: recovered Parenthood succession record and December2014 executive-role observation; distinguished later board directorship from executive employment using2020 organisational release. Separated Queensland UWU role observed2020 from national role confirmed2024. Added2008–2010 study context without assigning those dates to paid employment.

Avenues: first speech, public professional profile retrieval with hidden experience fields, QUT/IHBI psychology/therapist searches,2014–15 Australian Progress annual report, contemporaneous authored article,2020 Parenthood release,2020 Queensland testimony and2024 Senate hearing program. No dated university employment contract or Logan placement/pay evidence found. First speech does not support derivative assertion of2019 move/national appointment; do not adopt it against distinct2020 Queensland title. Follow-up: QUT/IHBI employment dates/FTE/legal contract, Logan placement status, ministerial staff/campaign leave boundaries, United Voice chronology, executive-to-board transition and governance dates, UWU promotion/leave/resignation. Missing evidence remains unknown, not zero.

Follow-up2October2026: primary Queensland Hansard identifies previously omitted Phil Reeves electorate-officer employment in2006-election context; no personal contract dates or hours inferred. Contemporary2019 candidate analysis supplies United Voice organiser title. QUT/IHBI searches under Jo and Joanna located a UQ repository report, Provision of Strategies to Support Drug and Alcohol Services, https://espace.library.uq.edu.au/view/UQ%3A258304/ReviewOnlineAOD.pdf, indexed acknowledgement to Joanna Briskey. Direct open returned Internal Error; acknowledgement alone does not identify employer, payment, therapist role or dates, so retained as research lead only. MUA Queensland8February2019 bulletin corroborates advocacy history but membership of the Missos on first job does not prove that union was her first employer. Next retrieve report acknowledgement context and QUT project appointments; confirm Logan placement/pay status, Reeves employment interval and transition to ministerial office, union and Parenthood boundaries. No employment totals manufactured.

Third follow-up3October2026: official Senate hearing program establishes the National Political Coordinator, Parliamentary Affairs title by20August2020, substantially earlier than the prior October2024 observation. A Queensland Political Coordinator title is recorded on10August2020; without organisational records, these closely spaced titles are not forced into a single transition date or assumed concurrent appointments. QUT/IHBI and Logan searches still found no appointment/pay evidence, and no Reeves-to-ministerial or Parenthood-to-union boundaries were resolved. No headline totals changed.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: exact-name QUT/IHBI, research-therapist, Geoff Wilson office and United Voice chronology searches returned the same broad candidate profile and later derivative summaries, not primary appointment, payroll or hours evidence. The ABC profile confirms study alongside tutoring/research work and leave for the2012 candidacy, but does not identify which employer granted leave or supply dates. A2019 union bulletin repeats five years at The Parenthood and broad union-advocacy history without resolving executive commencement/cessation or earlier organiser terms. The derivative claim of a2019 move to Victoria remains unadopted because primary2020 records show closely spaced Queensland and national titles. University, Logan, ministerial, union and Parenthood boundaries remain unresolved; no headline change.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Full first-speech re-read recovered previously omitted first post-school job at Alex Hills hotel bottle shop, separate from union membership; added UQ bachelor study with unknown dates. Public profile2003–2007 education row has hidden labels and was not assigned to the bachelor; Advoc8 unreferenced2007 graduation claim remains unverified. A2010 Queensland briefing-register index names Briskey, but PDF text search did not recover those rows and ordinary retrieval returnedHTTP403; no new ministerial employer or boundary inferred. UQ drug/alcohol report returned403; acknowledgement remains a lead rather than employment evidence. Next seek bottle-shop legal employer/dates/hours alongside QUT appointments, Logan pay and staff/union transitions.

Fifth follow-up 5 October 2026: both-engine targeted QUT research-therapist, Logan, ministerial-office and earlier-work searches returned existing ABC chronology, derivative biographies and unrelated people rather than an original appointment/pay record. Reviewed later personal parliamentary speeches on mental health (26 November 2025) and prescribing (4 February 2026); their service-policy discussions add no dated personal clinical employment or hours. Qualification as a psychologist is not proof of a full-time paid clinical spell; Logan remains unspecified experience, not assumed employment. Public Advoc8 education assertions remain unreferenced leads; no graduation date or employer transferred. Future useful evidence is an original public CV, QUT/IHBI contract or staff declaration and ministerial/union transition documentation. The bottle-shop legal employer, personal hours, breaks and all unresolved boundaries are retained; no numerical change.
